items.caption: An oracle-bone form of 年 has a branching grain-like element above a human-shaped lower element. It illustrates the interpretation of grain carried by a person in an early harvest context.
items.alt: Black oracle-bone-style graph on white, with a branching upper form above a separate human-shaped lower form.
items.selection_reason: The visible form is legible and matches the sourced interpretation of 年 as grain above a person associated with harvest. The pictorial reading does not establish whether the lower element also had a phonetic role.

limitations.text: The image is a modern redraw. Whether the lower 人 also served as a sound component remains disputed, and the reported change to 千 has not been verified against a dated sequence of inspected forms.
